summary.text: Kate Lieber is a Democratic member of the Oregon State Senate for District 14, which her biography says includes Beaverton and southwest Portland.
She is co-chair of the Joint Committee on Ways and Means, the legislature's budget-writing committee.

paragraphs.text: Lieber's biography describes her as an attorney and former community college instructor, and says she is a mother of two.
It says she worked as a Multnomah County prosecutor and later served on the Oregon Psychiatric Security Review Board and the board of Transition Projects.

In the legislature, according to the page, she is focused on ending the criminalization of poverty and mental illness, improving access to safe and affordable housing, supporting workers' rights to organize, and supporting working caregivers.
